issue.title: [test gap] A test case is required to validate unexpected vlan tag in bounced back traffic

failure.body:
**Description**

A test case is required to cover the issue in [CS00012263713 ](https://brcmsemiconductor-csm.wolkenservicedesk.com/wolken-support/mycases/request-details?requestId=12263713)

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Toggle all mux cable to upper ToR, so the mux cables are standby on lower ToR
2. Shutdown 3 BGP sessions to T1, only keep one BGP session up.
3. Send packet to lower ToR, the dest ip of the packet is a server's IP
4. Check the packet is bounced back to T1, and there is no vlan tag in the bounced back traffic.

**Describe the results you received:**

**Describe the results you expected:**
There should be no vlan tag in the bounced back traffic.

resolution.title: Add testcase to verify vlan header in bounced back traffic
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary:
Fixes #6427
This PR is to add a test case to fill a test gap in #6427
We found that there will be an unexpected vlan header in the bounced back traffic from standby ToR after mirror session is added.
This PR is to add a test case to verify that.

### Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [x] Test case(new/improvement)

### Back port request
- [ ] 201911
- [ ] 202012
- [ ] 202205

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?

#### How did you do it?
This PR is to add a test case to fill a test gap in #6427
Test steps
1. Random selected a ToR for testing
2. Toggle mux cable to the unselected ToR, so that the selected one is standby
3. Shutdown other uplinks, only keep one uplink up on the selected ToR. This is to ensure the monitor port of mirror session is the port where the bounced back traffic is egressed
4. Send packet to the selected ToR, verify there is no unexpected vlan id in the bounced back traffic

#### How did you verify/test it?
The test case is verified on a Arista-7260cx3 dualtor testbed.

#### Any platform specific information?
No.
#### Supported testbed topology if it's a new test case?
A dualtor specify test case.
